title: A Autopsy for the Will
author: E. M. Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Ashgrove, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
